task: Draft a warranty-disclaimer clause for a fictional software-licensing agreement using the supplied facts. Do not add warranty exceptions, jurisdiction-specific limitations, or licensee-name references not in the facts.

facts.text: The fictional licensor is Sorvex Technologies Inc.
The software is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind.
Sorvex expressly disclaims all implied warranties, including merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose.
The disclaimer applies to the extent permitted by applicable law.
